title: Path-Measure Dynamics of Attention-Driven World Models: A Nonlocal Onsager--Machlup Approach
summary: Attention enables a world model to condition on its entire history, providing long-term memory that facilitates long-range predictions. While the local Onsager--Machlup theory in our companion paper assumes a temporally local predictive action, we investigate the conditions under which this locality holds. We derive the predictive path measure for latent dynamics that become non-Markovian due to attention-induced memory, demonstrating that this measure is the projection of a hidden linear Markov augmentation. Eliminating the auxiliary field results in a nonlocal Onsager--Machlup action, where memory manifests as a nonlocal quadratic form rather than a force. These kernels are completely monotone and exactly match a hidden Markov embedding with a finite relaxation spectrum; otherwise, the dynamics remain fundamentally nonlocal. By expanding the action in terms of the scale-separation parameter $ε=τ_{\text{mem}}/τ_{\text{dyn}}$, we show that the leading order recovers the local action of the companion paper, establishing locality as the short-memory limit of a nonlocal theory. We verify the reversible sector of this expansion term by term against an exactly solvable vector linear model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究注意力机制引入记忆后潜变量动力学的非马尔可夫性，通过隐式线性马尔可夫增广得到非局域Onsager-Machlup作用量，并在短记忆极限下恢复局域理论。
AI.motivation: 同伴论文假设了时间局域的预测作用量，本文旨在探究注意力引入记忆后该局域性成立的条件，以及非局域效应如何涌现。
AI.method: 推导注意力诱导记忆下的预测路径测度，将其表示为隐式线性马尔可夫增广的投影；通过尺度分离参数展开作用量，并利用可精确求解的矢量线性模型进行验证。
AI.result: 记忆表现为非局域二次型而非力的形式；核函数完全单调且与有限弛豫谱的隐马尔可夫嵌入精确匹配；短记忆极限下恢复局域理论。
AI.conclusion: 局域性是短记忆极限下的近似，当记忆不可忽略时动力学本质上是非局域的。

title: Evidence for Deconfined Magnetic Order in the Kitaev-$J_3$ Model
summary: We investigate the Kitaev-$J_3$ honeycomb model using variational Monte Carlo calculations combined with a vison-quasiparticle analysis of the parent Kitaev spin liquid (KSL). We provide evidence for deconfined magnetic phases in which zigzag or antiferromagnetic order coexists with remnant $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological structure inherited from the KSL. The optimized variational wave functions retain multiple linearly independent topological sectors on a torus, whereas those of conventional ordered phases collapse to a single sector. The vison-quasiparticle analysis shows that magnetic order naturally arises from vison-pair condensation while single visons remain gapped, yielding a microscopic mechanism for magnetic ordering without immediate confinement. The resulting phases further host gapless spinons with multiple Majorana cones, offering a possible microscopic scenario for the anomalous low-temperature longitudinal thermal transport reported in magnetically ordered Kitaev materials such as Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$. Our results reveal a microscopic route to fractionalized magnetism beyond the conventional dichotomy between magnetic order and spin-liquid behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变分蒙特卡洛和vison准粒子分析，研究了Kitaev-J₃蜂窝模型，发现退禁闭磁性相（zigzag和反铁磁序）可与Kitaev自旋液体的ℤ₂拓扑结构共存，并揭示了vison对凝聚导致磁性有序的微观机制，为Na₂Co₂TeO₆等材料的反常低温热输运提供了理论解释。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为磁有序和自旋液体是互斥的，但实验在Kitaev材料（如Na₂Co₂TeO₆）中发现了磁性有序态下的反常热输运信号。本文旨在探索磁性序与拓扑自旋液体属性能否共存，并揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 采用变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）计算，并结合vison准粒子分析。在环面上优化变分波函数，检查拓扑扇区数量；通过vison对凝聚机制分析磁性有序的起源。
AI.result: 发现了zigzag和反铁磁序与ℤ₂拓扑结构共存的退禁闭磁性相；有序相波函数保留多个独立拓扑扇区（常规有序相仅一个扇区）；磁有序源于vison对凝聚（单个vison仍有能隙）；这些相中存在带多个Majorana锥的无能隙自旋子。
AI.conclusion: 建立了"vison对凝聚→磁性有序+保留拓扑结构"的微观图像，打破了磁有序与自旋液体的传统二分法，为解释Kitaev材料中的分数化磁性现象提供了理论框架。

title: Many-body benchmarking of DFT local-registry energetics in bilayer InSe
summary: Density functional theory (DFT) is widely used to model twisted bilayers, but the accuracy of the local stacking energetics underlying such models remains uncertain. Here, we benchmark the local-registry landscape of bilayer InSe using diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (DMC). DFT predicts that AB, AAr, and ABr stackings, which share the same interfacial Se registry, are nearly degenerate within 1.5 meV/f.u. and exhibit nearly indistinguishable DFT charge-density responses. DMC instead separates these stackings by 8(5) and 41(4) meV/f.u., while the energy difference between the most stable and least stable registries reaches 60(7) meV/f.u.. These large energy separations show that the stacking energetics are not determined by the interfacial atomic motif alone but depend on the full registry and its associated many-body electronic response. More broadly, these results show that DFT-based moiré models can substantially underestimate local stacking-energy corrugation, with direct consequences for predicted structural relaxation, domain formation, and electronic reconstruction in twisted layered materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩散量子蒙特卡洛（DMC）方法对双层InSe的局部堆叠能量景观进行基准测试，发现DFT严重低估了不同堆叠构型之间的能量差异（最大可达60 meV/f.u.），表明基于DFT的莫尔模型可能显著低估局部堆叠能量起伏，影响对扭曲层状材料中结构弛豫、畴形成和电子重构的预测。
AI.motivation: DFT广泛应用于扭曲双层材料的建模，但其对局部堆叠能量学的准确性尚不确定，因此需要更高精度的基准测试来评估DFT的可靠性。
AI.method: 使用扩散量子蒙特卡洛（DMC）方法对双层InSe的局部堆叠能量景观进行高精度基准计算，并与DFT结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: DFT预测AB、AAr和ABr三种堆叠（共享相同界面Se配位）能量差在1.5 meV/f.u.以内，电荷密度响应几乎无法区分；而DMC显示这些堆叠的能量差分别为8(5)和41(4) meV/f.u.，最稳定与最不稳定构型能量差达60(7) meV/f.u.。
AI.conclusion: 堆叠能量学不仅由界面原子构型决定，还取决于完整配位及其多体电子响应。基于DFT的莫尔模型可能严重低估局部堆叠能量起伏，进而影响对扭曲层状材料中结构弛豫、畴形成和电子重构的预测。

title: The Wigner function for Integer quantum Hall effect
summary: Wigner's quasi-probability distribution function in phase space is a specialized representation of the density matrix, possessing significant physical importance. In this article, we first review the wave function describing electronic motion in an electromagnetic field under the Landau gauge. Next, based on an introduction to the properties of the Wigner function, we calculate the Wigner function for the integer quantum Hall effect using the integral method.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了朗道规范下电磁场中电子运动的波函数，并利用积分方法计算了整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数。
AI.motivation: Wigner准概率分布函数在相空间中具有重要的物理意义，是密度矩阵的一种特殊表示。本文旨在通过计算整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数，展示其在实际物理系统中的应用。
AI.method: 首先回顾朗道规范下电磁场中电子运动的波函数描述，然后介绍Wigner函数的性质，最后利用积分方法计算整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数。
AI.result: 成功利用积分方法计算了整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数，得到了其在相空间中的具体形式。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过计算整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数，展示了Wigner准概率分布函数在量子霍尔效应研究中的应用价值。

title: Theory of collective learning in populations of adaptive agents
summary:
We investigate homogeneous populations of smart active agents that exchange information with their neighbors to perform a decentralized learning process aimed at achieving a prescribed macroscopic state. Such agents may, for example, represent simple microrobots. The exchanged information comprises tunable parameters governing the agent dynamics, referred to as the individual policy, together with an internal memory encoding previously visited states. This memory is used to evaluate a reward that quantifies the success of a policy to achieve the prescribed state. We extend the kinetic-theory description of collective learning in spatially homogeneous systems [Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 248302 (2025)] and derive formal evolution equations for the distribution of policies across the population. A central outcome of our theory is the emergence of an effective reward function that fully determines the evolution of the policy distribution and encapsulates the microscopic details of the agents physical and memory dynamics. We obtain closed equations for the policy mean and variance which admit explicit time-dependent solutions under the assumption of Gaussian-distributed memories and polices.
  To illustrate the framework, we present a series of minimal microscopic models, considering both perfect and partial separation of physical, memory and policy exchange time scales, as well as models with one- and two-dimensional policies. The obtained theoretical results compare well with agent-based numerical simulations. The theory captures key aspects of collective learning, including the influence of population diversity and reward fluctuations on learning performance. Finally, we discuss potential applications to swarm robotics and machine learning, and highlight connections with classical models of biological evolution, including the Replicator equation and the Moran model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了智能活性剂群体通过交换策略参数和记忆信息进行分散式学习以实现宏观状态的过程，推导了策略分布的演化方程，并发现有效奖励函数决定了策略分布的演化。理论结果与多尺度微观模型和智能体模拟吻合良好，揭示了群体多样性和奖励波动对学习性能的影响，并与复制者方程、Moran模型等生物进化模型建立了联系。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解同质智能活性剂群体（如微型机器人）通过局部信息交换进行分散式学习的动力学机制，并建立理论框架来描述群体策略分布的演化过程。
AI.method: 扩展了空间均匀系统中集体学习的动理学描述（Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 248302 (2025)），推导了策略分布的正式演化方程。引入了有效奖励函数概念，假设记忆和策略服从高斯分布，得到了策略均值和方差的封闭方程及显式时间依赖解。
AI.result: 理论结果与基于智能体的数值模拟吻合良好，成功捕捉了群体多样性和奖励波动对学习性能的影响，并在不同时间尺度分离和不同维度策略的微观模型中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该理论框架为理解集体学习提供了基础，有望应用于群体机器人和机器学习领域，且与Replicator方程、Moran模型等经典生物进化模型存在深刻联系。

title: Plaid-Like Spin Splitting and Chirality of Magnon Bands in Antiferromagnetic MnTe$_2$
summary: Altermagnets constitute an emerging class of magnetic materials that combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with spin-split excitations arising from crystalline symmetries. Despite strong theoretical interest, their experimental identification remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that helicity- and angle-resolved Raman scattering measurements reveal reduced rotational symmetries of magnons and a pronounced imbalance between left- and right-circular polarization channels, indicating momentum-dependent magnon handedness. First-principles DFT+$U$ calculations combined with linear spin-wave theory uncover a characteristic plaid-like spin-splitting structure in momentum space. The resulting magnon spin textures are dictated by the unconventional sublattice symmetries of MnTe$_2$ and closely emulate those of altermagnetic electronic bands. Our work provides evidence of chiral spin-wave excitations unique to this non-coplanar antiferromagnet.

AI.tldr: 通过旋光性和角度分辨拉曼散射，实验证实MnTe₂中存在交替磁体特有的手性自旋波激发，并揭示了动量空间中的格子状自旋劈裂结构。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体作为新兴磁性材料虽有强烈理论兴趣，但实验识别仍然困难。本文旨在通过拉曼散射实验手段，验证交替磁体中手性自旋波激发的存在。
AI.method: 采用旋光性和角度分辨拉曼散射测量；结合第一性原理DFT+U计算与线性自旋波理论进行理论分析。
AI.result: 发现磁振子旋转对称性降低，左旋与右旋圆偏振通道存在显著不平衡；揭示动量空间中的格子状自旋劈裂结构，且磁振子自旋纹理由MnTe₂的非传统亚晶格对称性决定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为这类非共面反铁磁体中独特的手性自旋波激发提供了实验证据，并表明磁振子行为与交替磁体电子带结构高度相似。

title: Quantum-geometric shift of quasiequilibrium: Origin of nonreciprocal current driven by quantum-metric dipole
summary: We study nonlinear DC electric transport of quantum-metric origin by combining adiabatic perturbation theory with the nonequilibrium Green function approach. The adiabatic ansatz provides a basis for directly treating a DC electric field in the velocity gauge, rather than introducing it as the zero-frequency limit of an AC field. The resulting adiabatic-basis Hamiltonian takes the same form as in the length gauge, enabling a systematic comparison across different formulations. Applying this fully quantum formulation, we find a longitudinal nonreciprocal current governed by the quantum-metric dipole. The essential ingredient is a quantum correction to the distribution function that is absent in semiclassical treatments. We trace this correction to the finite spread of an electron wave packet during relaxation under a bias field, thereby identifying shifted quasiequilibrium as the physical origin of quantum-metric nonreciprocal transport.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合绝热微扰论和非平衡格林函数方法，从量子度规角度研究非线性直流电输运，发现由量子度规偶极子驱动的纵向非互易电流，并将其物理起源归因于偏压场下电子波包有限展宽导致的偏移准平衡态。
AI.motivation: 现有的非线性电输运研究大多基于半经典处理，无法完整捕捉量子度规（波函数的几何性质）对直流输运的贡献；此外，长度规范和速度规范下的理论框架存在不一致性，需要建立统一的量子力学表述。
AI.method: 将绝热微扰论与非平衡格林函数方法结合，在速度规范下直接处理直流电场（而非将其视为交流场的零频极限），构建绝热基哈密顿量，使其与长度规范下的形式一致，从而进行系统比较。
AI.result: 发现存在由量子度规偶极子（quantum-metric dipole）驱动的纵向非互易电流；该电流的关键贡献来自于分布函数的量子修正项，这一修正项在半经典理论中完全缺失。
AI.conclusion: 该量子修正源于偏压场下电子波包在弛豫过程中的有限空间展宽，导致体系进入“偏移准平衡态”（shifted quasiequilibrium），这即是量子度规非互易输运的物理本质。

title: Exact amplitude relations for diffusion-limited aggregation
summary: It has been known for several decades that the third moment of the multifractal spectrum of the harmonic measure for diffusion-limited aggregates is linked to the underlying fractal dimension of the cluster. We demonstrate, using an argument based on the Hastings-Levitov formulation of diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) in two dimensions, an even stronger link, connecting the universal amplitude of the third moment to the cluster fractal dimension. This argument can be used for both the standard circular DLA as well as DLA in a cylinder (i.e., with periodic boundary conditions).

AI.tldr: 本文通过Hastings-Levitov方法证明了二维扩散限制聚集(DLA)中调和测度的三阶矩通用振幅与团簇分形维度之间存在强关联，该结论适用于标准圆形DLA和圆柱形（周期性边界条件）DLA。
AI.motivation: 此前仅知DLA中调和测度多分形谱的三阶矩与团簇分形维度有关，但缺乏更精确的定量联系。作者希望建立三阶矩的通用振幅与分形维度之间的直接数学关联。
AI.method: 基于Hastings-Levitov公式化方法，通过数学论证推导调和测度三阶矩的通用振幅与DLA团簇分形维度的关系，并分别分析标准圆形DLA和圆柱周期性边界条件下的DLA。
AI.result: 发现三阶矩的通用振幅与团簇分形维度之间存在比以往更强的数学联系，且该联系对两种边界条件均成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作深化了对DLA中调和测度普适性的理解，提供了连接多分形谱与分形维度的新纽带，为后续理论研究提供了基础。

title: Unconventional Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Rare-Earth Tetraborides
comment: Main manuscript: 10 pages, 4 figures, Supplementary Material: 12 pages, 11 figures, 1 table
summary: Altermagnetism has advanced the study of compensated magnets by revealing non-relativistic spin splitting, traditionally classified into strictly even- or odd-parity spin textures. Here, we unveil a fundamentally different regime: component-resolved mixed-parity spin splitting in a fully three-dimensional compensated magnet. Using first-principles calculations, tight-binding and $\mathbf{k} \cdot \mathbf{p}$ models, along with spin-group symmetry analysis, we demonstrate that the non-coplanar ground state of $\mathrm{TbB}_4$ enforces a unique momentum-space spin texture. The in-plane spin components exhibit odd-parity $p$- and $f$-wave-like textures, whereas the out-of-plane component retains an even-parity $d$-wave altermagnetic character. Crucially, the coexistence of the in-plane odd-parity textures is driven not by relativistic spin-orbit coupling, but by a staggered Berry phase arising from the inherent scalar spin chirality. This mixed-parity structure dictates distinct transport fingerprints, including bulk non-relativistic Edelstein and spin Hall responses, as well as a symmetry-allowed Berry curvature dipole. These results establish the rare-earth tetraborides as a robust platform for engineering complex spin-charge conversion phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了TbB₄中一种全新的混合宇称自旋劈裂机制：面内自旋分量呈现奇宇称p/f波纹理，而面外分量保持偶宇称d波交磁特性，这种非相对论性效应源于标量自旋手性引起的交错Berry相位，并导致体Edelstein效应、自旋霍尔响应及Berry曲率偶极子等独特输运现象。
AI.motivation: 传统交磁学研究将非相对论性自旋劈裂严格归类为偶宇称或奇宇称自旋纹理，作者希望探索是否存在两者共存的混合宇称态，并理解其物理起源和输运特征。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、k·p模型以及自旋群对称性分析，对TbB₄的非共面基态进行系统研究。
AI.result: 发现TbB₄中面内自旋分量呈现奇宇称p/f波纹理，面外分量保持偶宇称d波交磁特性；这种混合宇称结构由标量自旋手性引发的交错Berry相位驱动（非自旋轨道耦合）；导致体非相对论性Edelstein效应、自旋霍尔响应和Berry曲率偶极子。
AI.conclusion: 稀土四硼化物可作为工程化复杂自旋-电荷转换现象的稳健平台，为混合宇称自旋劈裂研究开辟了新方向。

title: Density functional study of native point defects in CaO
summary: We investigate the structural, electronic, and optical properties of native point defects in CaO using first-principles density-functional calculations. Oxygen vacancies are favored under O-poor conditions, whereas calcium vacancies dominate under O-rich conditions. Calculated migration barriers and binding energies indicate that vacancy complexes are thermodynamically stable and can survive high-temperature annealing. Optical transition energies, evaluated using the Franck-Condon framework, suggest that several experimentally observed absorption and emission peaks can be attributed to negatively charged vacancy complexes as well as isolated oxygen vacancies.

AI.tldr: 使用第一性原理密度泛函计算研究了CaO中本征点缺陷的结构、电子和光学性质，发现氧空位在贫氧条件下更易形成，钙空位在富氧条件下占主导，空位复合物热力学稳定且能解释多种实验观测到的光学峰。
AI.motivation: 理解和表征CaO中本征点缺陷的结构、电子和光学性质，为实验观测到的吸收和发射峰提供理论解释。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函计算（DFT），计算迁移势垒和结合能，利用Franck-Condon框架评估光学跃迁能量。
AI.result: 氧空位在贫氧条件下最稳定，钙空位在富氧条件下占主导；空位复合物具有热力学稳定性且能经受高温退火；多种实验观测到的光学峰可归因于带负电的空位复合物和孤立氧空位。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了CaO中本征点缺陷的形成机制与稳定性，成功将理论计算的光学跃迁能与实验观测的光学特征对应起来。

title: A 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine for number partitioning and Sudoku
summary: Optical coherent Ising machines based on time-multiplexing have demonstrated significant progress in terms of connectivity and spin scalability. However, they are constrained by large physical footprints, high power consumption, poor thermal stability, and high cost. Here, we present a time-multiplexed Ising machine leveraging propagating wave packets in solid-state delay lines at microwave frequencies, enabling thermally stable, robust, low-power, tabletop, and affordable design. We use two serially connected 20.5 MHz, 707 μs bulk acoustic wave delay lines supporting 2,048 spins. Our design provides all-to-all connectivity with 15-bit coupling resolution and finds approximate MAX-CUT solutions in 341 ms, potentially scalable to sub-ms by using higher frequency delay lines. Additionally, we demonstrate solutions to number partitioning and Sudoku problems. Compared with state-of-the-art Coherent Ising machines, our machine exhibits four orders of magnitude higher thermal stability. Against the simulated bifurcation algorithm, our design achieves comparable results on the MAX-CUT problem, while outperforming it on the more complex number-partitioning and Sudoku problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于微波固态延迟线的时分伊辛机，利用体声波延迟线实现2048个自旋的全连接，具有高热稳定性、低功耗、低成本等优势，在MAX-CUT、数划分和数独问题上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有基于时分复用的光学相干伊辛机存在物理尺寸大、功耗高、热稳定性差和成本高的问题，亟需一种更稳定、紧凑、低功耗的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用两个串联的20.5 MHz、707 μs体声波延迟线，以微波频段的传播波包作为自旋载体，实现2048个自旋的全连接伊辛机，具备15位耦合分辨率。
AI.result: 在341 ms内找到MAX-CUT近似解；热稳定性比现有相干伊辛机高四个数量级；在MAX-CUT问题上与模拟分岔算法相当，在数划分和数独问题上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该微波固态延迟线伊辛机为组合优化问题提供了一种热稳定、低功耗、低成本且可扩展至亚毫秒级求解的方案。

title: Alternative routes to universal diversity scaling in component systems: from proteomes to large language models
summary: Remarkably common statistical laws characterize the diversity scaling and its fluctuations across a wide range of complex "component systems". These regularities are often interpreted as signatures of an underlying innovation mechanism driving the growth of component diversity, but the basic ingredients necessary for their emergence remain poorly understood. In particular, from language and technological artifacts to genomes and gene expression patterns, the number of distinct components grows sublinearly with system size, while its variance scales approximately as the square of its mean. This behavior is consistent across diverse systems, raising the question of whether general constraints or emergent principles underlying diversity and innovation define the architectures of realizations with different numbers of components. To address this question, we derive analytical conditions for the joint emergence of these two diversity laws within a broad class of growth models, showing that they require a specific asymptotic dependence of the innovation probability on diversity and system size. We then demonstrate that the same macroscopic laws arise in a different class of models with latent heterogeneity, where quadratic fluctuation scaling always emerges asymptotically as a consequence of general statistical principles, essentially the law of total variance, without explicitly assuming an innovation mechanism or any specific rule for system assembly. We compare these predictions with empirical data from language, genomes, LEGO constructions, and texts generated by large language models. Our results show that empirical diversity scaling laws strongly constrain generative models but do not uniquely identify the mechanisms generating diversity, revealing a close correspondence between innovation-driven growth models and latent-variable descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了复杂系统中多样性增长的两个普适统计规律——系统规模增加时不同组分数量的亚线性增长及其方差与均值的平方成正比——并证明这些规律既可由创新驱动增长模型产生，也可由潜在异质性模型产生，两者在宏观上难以区分。
AI.motivation: 从语言、技术制品到基因组和基因表达模式，多样性标度及其波动呈现出惊人的普适统计规律。这些规律常被解读为创新机制驱动多样性增长的信号，但其涌现的基本条件尚不明确。作者旨在揭示产生这些普适规律的必要条件，并探究不同生成机制在宏观规律层面的可区分性。
AI.method: 作者首先推导了创新驱动增长模型中两个多样性定律联合涌现的解析条件，发现这要求创新概率对多样性和系统规模具有特定的渐近依赖性。随后证明在潜在异质性模型中，二次方差-均值关系作为总方差定律的必然结果始终渐近成立，无需显式假设创新机制。最后通过语言、基因组、LEGO构建和LLM生成文本等实证数据进行比较验证。
AI.result: 实证多样性标度律对生成模型施加了强约束，但并不能唯一确定产生多样性的机制。创新驱动增长模型与潜在变量描述之间存在紧密对应关系，两者在宏观统计规律上难以区分。
AI.conclusion: 普适的多样性标度律虽然能有效约束生成模型，但不足以唯一识别其背后的机制。不同模型族（创新驱动与潜在异质性）可以在宏观层面表现出相同的统计规律，说明对多样性涌现的解释需要更多微观层面的约束。

title: Phonon spectral function of Holstein polaron: Investigation of many-body effects with self-energy and vertex correction
summary: We study the impact of the many-body effects on the phonon spectral function of Holstein polaron in one-dimension in the antiadiabatic regime by incorporating the contributions from the electron self-energy and vertex corrections within a weak-coupling approach that respects the charge-conserving Ward identity. We find that while the polaronic spectral weight is suppressed due to contribution from the electron self-energy, on the other hand, the same is enhanced due to contribution from the vertex corrections. While strength of both the contributions increases with increasing the wave vector ($\q$) of phonons, they nearly cancel each other for the small-$\q$ modes so that the polaronic spectral weight is weakly affected due to the many-body effects. For the large-$\q$ modes near the zone boundary, the net many-body correction is dominated by the contribution of the electron self-energy which increases faster in comparison to that of the vertex corrections with increasing the wave vector thereby resulting in a significant suppression of the polaronic spectral weight. We find that while the weak-coupling perturbative approach provides a reliable estimation of the impact of the many-body effects deep inside the antiadibatic regime, the renormalization of quasiparticle spectrum must be taken into account for an accurate estimation when the phonon energy approaches the electronic bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维Holstein极化子在反绝热区中多体效应对声子谱函数的影响，发现电子自能和顶点修正分别抑制和增强极化子谱权重，两者在小波矢区域几乎抵消，而在大波矢区域自能占主导导致谱权重显著抑制。
AI.motivation: 探究一维Holstein极化子在反绝热区域中多体效应对声子谱函数的影响，特别是电子自能和顶点修正的竞争机制。
AI.method: 采用满足电荷守恒Ward恒等式的弱耦合方法，同时纳入电子自能和顶点修正的贡献来研究声子谱函数。
AI.result: 电子自能抑制极化子谱权重，顶点修正增强谱权重；小波矢模式下两者几乎抵消，大波矢（靠近布里渊区边界）模式下自能占主导导致谱权重显著抑制。
AI.conclusion: 弱耦合微扰方法在深反绝热区可可靠估计多体效应，但当声子能量接近电子带宽时需考虑准粒子谱的重整化才能获得准确估计。

title: Quantifying angular momentum of coherently driven circular phonons
summary: The use of intense terahertz (THz) pulses to manipulate low-energy excitations offers a powerful approach for ultrafast control of electronic and magnetic properties in materials. Theory suggests that circular ionic motions driven by THz fields carry angular momentum, potentially generating internal magnetic fields. Recent experiments in nonmagnetic SrTiO3 (STO) have hinted at such THz-induced fields, but their origin remains debated. Here, we employ ultrafast x-ray diffraction to resolve the time-dependent ionic trajectories in STO following excitation by circularly polarized THz pulses. Our analysis reveals that oxygen ions, despite their lower mass, contribute around 90% of the phonon angular momentum. The resulting imbalance between the negatively and positively charged ions provides a clear explanation for the mechanism behind induced magnetism in STO. This work further provides the first quantitative measurement of circular ionic motions and their angular momentum and establishes a general methodology for the investigation of angular momentum transfer in solids, paving the way for new strategies to control topological phonon transport and phonon-driven magnetism in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 利用超快X射线衍射技术，本文首次定量测量了非磁性SrTiO3中由圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发的氧离子环状运动，发现氧离子贡献了约90%的声子角动量，解释了太赫兹诱导磁性的机制。
AI.motivation: 太赫兹脉冲可操纵低能激发实现超快控制材料性质，但非磁性SrTiO3中观察到的太赫兹诱导磁场起源存在争议，亟需揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 采用超快X射线衍射技术，解析圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发后SrTiO3中离子的时间依赖轨迹，定量测量环状离子运动及其角动量。
AI.result: 氧离子尽管质量较轻，却贡献了约90%的声子角动量；正负离子间的角动量不平衡是诱导磁性的根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 首次定量测量了环状离子运动及其角动量，建立了研究固体中角动量转移的通用方法，为控制拓扑声子输运和声子驱动磁性提供了新策略。

title: Electrical transport in ultra-thin films: from Fuchs-Sondheimer to quantum-confinement
summary: Ultra-thin films are fundamental components of modern nanoelectronics, where reducing thickness to the few-nanometer scale leads to a dramatic increase in electrical resistivity. For decades, this behavior has been interpreted in terms of classical size effects, primarily surface scattering within the Fuchs--Sondheimer theory and grain-boundary scattering in the Mayadas--Shatzkes model. While these approaches successfully describe transport when the film thickness is comparable to the electronic mean free path, growing experimental evidence indicates that they become insufficient under extreme confinement. This review discusses the crossover from classical scattering to a quantum-confinement regime in which the electronic states available for transport are fundamentally restructured by finite size. We review the recently proposed reciprocal-space confinement theory, which predicts an exponential increase of resistivity with decreasing thickness at the nanoscale, and discuss how it can be combined with classical surface-scattering models to provide a unified description of ultra-thin metallic and semiconducting films. Finally, we summarize recent experimental evidence supporting this picture and discuss its implications for future nanoelectronic devices, nanoscale interconnects, and quantum transport under extreme spatial confinement.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了超薄膜从经典尺寸效应（Fuchs-Sondheimer表面散射和Mayadas-Shatzkes晶界散射）到量子限域效应的转变，重点介绍了倒易空间限域理论及其与经典模型的统一描述，并总结了支持该理论的实验证据及其对纳米电子器件的影响。
AI.motivation: 经典尺寸效应模型在超薄膜极端限域条件下（厚度降至几纳米）失效，实验证据日益增多，因此需要发展新的理论框架来解释电阻率随厚度减小的异常增长行为。
AI.method: 回顾并整合了倒易空间限域理论，该理论预测电阻率随厚度减小呈指数增长；并将其与经典表面散射模型（Fuchs-Sondheimer、Mayadas-Shatzkes）相结合，构建统一的描述框架。
AI.result: 倒易空间限域理论成功预测了纳米尺度下电阻率随厚度减小的指数增长行为，且与经典模型结合后能统一描述超薄金属和半导体薄膜的输运特性。
AI.conclusion: 该统一理论为未来纳米电子器件、纳米互连及极端空间限域下的量子输运提供了新的理论依据与设计指导。

title: How wrong is too wrong: A numerical study on the relevance of positional memory in the generalized Langevin equation
summary: If a generalized Langevin equation contains a potential of mean force, it cannot at the same time contain a linear memory kernel and a fluctuating force that obeys a second fluctuation dissipation theorem in the sense of Kubo, and be exact. As modelers often prefer to use generalized Langevin equations that have the first three properties, one needs to ask how close the model dynamics is to the dynamics of the underlying microscopic system. To test this, we analyze a simple model system in which the potential of mean force can be well approximated by a polynomial of low order. The exact generalized Langevin equation of this model contains memory terms in addition to the linear one. We show that these additional terms, at least for the model system regarded in this article, are important for the dynamics and cannot be neglected if one intends to model core aspects of the underlying system correctly.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，同时包含平均力势、线性记忆核和满足Kubo第二涨落-耗散定理的随机力的广义朗之万方程不可能精确成立。通过模型分析表明，除线性记忆外的高阶记忆项对动力学至关重要，不可忽略。
AI.motivation: 研究者通常偏好使用同时具有平均力势、线性记忆核和涨落-耗散定理三条性质的广义朗之万方程进行建模，但这样的方程不可能是精确的。因此需要评估这种近似模型动力学与底层微观系统真实动力学之间的偏差程度。
AI.method: 分析了一个平均力势可被低阶多项式良好近似的简单模型系统，推导其精确的广义朗之万方程，并与仅含线性记忆核的近似版本进行对比。
AI.result: 该模型的精确广义朗之万方程除了线性记忆项外，还包含额外的（高阶）记忆项。这些额外记忆项对动力学有重要影响。
AI.conclusion: 如果希望正确模拟底层系统的核心动力学行为，线性记忆之外的额外记忆项不能被忽略。

title: A density matrix renormalization group approach to quantum point contacts
summary: Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) combined with the correction-vector method, we investigate the competition between an harmonic potential and repulsive interactions in a one-dimensional fermionic system. The parabolic confinement induces spatial inhomogeneity, and by tuning its curvature one can continuously interpolate between a potential well--relevant for cold-atom setups--and a quantum barrier, as realized in mesoscopic systems such as quantum point contacts. We analyze how the ground-state particle distribution evolves with the strength and sign of the confining potential and how the confinement reshapes the spectral weight of the local density of states (LDOS) at the center of the chain. In the barrier regime, a localized peak emerges in the electron part of the spectrum ($ω>0$) as a direct consequence of the potential. In contrast, in the well configuration and for weak interactions, a localized feature persists but shifts to the hole sector ($ω<0$). However, for stronger interactions, the LDOS no longer displays clear signatures of the external potential, indicating that correlations dominate over single-particle confinement.

AI.tldr: 使用 DMRG 和修正向量方法，研究了谐波势与排斥相互作用在一维费米子系统中的竞争，分析了从势阱到量子势垒的转变及其对局域态密度的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究谐波势（包括势阱和势垒两种配置）如何与相互作用竞争，以及这种竞争如何影响一维费米子系统的基态粒子分布和局域态密度谱权重。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重整化群结合修正向量方法，通过调节谐波势的曲率强度和符号，实现从势阱（冷原子系统相关）到量子势垒（如量子点接触）的连续插值。
AI.result: 在势垒区，电子谱（ω>0）出现局域峰；在弱相互作用势阱区，局域特征移至空穴谱（ω<0）；强相互作用下，LDOS不再显示外势的明显特征，表明关联效应主导。
AI.conclusion: 相互作用强度足够大时，多体关联效应会掩盖外势对局域态密度的调制作用，表明系统从单粒子受限过渡到关联主导的量子态。

title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior
summary: Depositing various coatings on surface of engineering components with the aim to improve their performance concerning wear, corrosion, friction and thermal protection is already a standard practice. Depositing metallic NiTi shape memory alloy coatings may be a viable alternative for hard ceramic coatings. NiTi coatings offer additional benefits originating from unique functional thermomechanical properties. However, fabrication of thick NiTi coatings turned out to be difficult. Standard electroplating and laser cladding methods are not suitable for NiTi the most widely used plasma spray methods tend to produce chemically inhomogeneous coatings that do not transform martensitically, cold sprayed NiTi coatings suffer from poor adhesion to the substrates. In this work we report on first ever successful fabrication of thick NiTi coatings (100-300 um) that display functional thermomechanical properties and simultaneously show very good adherence to the substrate. We used high velocity air fuel thermal spray method to fabricate NiTi coatings deposited on mild steel using four different sets of processing parameters. Chemical composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation and functional thermomechanical properties of the NiTi coatings were evaluated. Although the coatings contain inhomogeneous microstructure, voids, oxide particles, high density of dislocation defects and internal stress, they undergo martensitic transformation upon cooling and or mechanical loading. As sprayed NiTi coatings need to be annealed to display functional thermomechanical properties. Despite their limited tensile strength, the coatings displayed thermal actuation in 3 point bending tests and shape memory effects in nanoindentation and scratch tests.

AI.tldr: 本文首次成功制备了100-300微米厚的NiTi形状记忆合金涂层，采用高速空气燃料热喷涂法在低碳钢上沉积，尽管涂层存在不均匀微观结构、空隙、氧化物颗粒、高密度位错缺陷和内应力，但经过退火处理后表现出马氏体相变、热驱动和形状记忆效应，且具有良好附着力。
AI.motivation: NiTi形状记忆合金涂层相比硬质陶瓷涂层具有独特的热机械功能特性，但现有制备方法（电镀、激光熔覆、等离子喷涂、冷喷涂）均难以制造出兼具功能特性和良好附着力的厚涂层，因此需要探索新的制备工艺。
AI.method: 采用高速空气燃料（HVAF）热喷涂法，使用四组不同工艺参数在低碳钢基体上沉积NiTi涂层；对涂层进行退火处理；通过化学组成、孔隙率、微观结构、相变和功能热机械性能评估涂层质量。
AI.result: 成功制备了100-300微米厚、附着力良好的NiTi涂层；涂层虽存在不均匀微观结构、空隙、氧化物、高密度位错和内应力，但可发生马氏体相变；退火是展现功能热机械性能的必要条件；在三点弯曲测试中显示热驱动效应，在纳米压痕和划痕测试中显示形状记忆效应，但拉伸强度有限。
AI.conclusion: HVAF热喷涂法可成功制备兼具功能热机械性能和良好附着力的NiTi厚涂层，为NiTi涂层的实际应用提供了可行的制备路径。

title: Entropy of Non-Abelian Anyons from Slow Quasiparticle Dynamics in Quantum Hall Interferometers
summary: Non-Abelian anyons emerging in fractional quantum Hall states carry a characteristic entropy, $ΔS = k_B \log d$, where \(d\) is the anyon's quantum dimension. This \(\mathcal{O}(1)\) entropy can, in principle, be extracted from charge measurements of an antidot via Maxwell relations. However, equilibrium charge measurements in fractional antidots have proven to be challenging with conventional charge detectors. Here, we propose a scheme based on an antidot embedded in an interferometer, in which the charge can be inferred from the recently observed time-dependent switching of the interference phase. Performing such non-local charge measurements at equilibrium, the characteristic \(\mathcal{O}(1)\) entropy of non-Abelian anyons (e.g., $d = \sqrt{2}$ for the $ν= 5/2$ state) can be extracted for intermediate temperatures, which exceed the level spacing of the interferometer edge, but are much smaller than the level spacing of the antidot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于干涉仪中嵌入反点的方案，通过非局域电荷测量提取分数量子霍尔态中非阿贝尔任意子的特征熵（ΔS = k_B log d），适用于中间温度范围。
AI.motivation: 非阿贝尔任意子携带有特征熵（ΔS = k_B log d），但传统电荷探测器难以在分数量子反点中实现平衡电荷测量，因此需要新方案。
AI.method: 将反点嵌入干涉仪中，通过观测干涉相位的时间相关开关来推断电荷，利用麦克斯韦关系从平衡电荷测量中提取任意子的特征熵。
AI.result: 在中间温度（大于干涉仪边缘能级间距但远小于反点能级间距）下，可以提取非阿贝尔任意子的特征熵，例如ν=5/2态的d=√2。
AI.conclusion: 该方案克服了传统平衡电荷测量的困难，为实验探测非阿贝尔任意子的量子维度提供了可行途径。

title: Velocity and force autocorrelations in Brownian dynamics with a Lorentz force
summary:
We derive a general relation between the velocity and force autocorrelation tensors (VACT and FACT) for a Brownian particle subject to an external magnetic field. Using time-symmetry arguments, we show that, for the full Langevin dynamics, the VACT depends only on the FACT, independently of the details of the interaction potential. Under the hypothesis of timescale separation between thermalization and interaction-driven motion, this relation simplifies considerably in the overdamped (Brownian) limit. A central feature of the overdamped result is that, unlike in the field-free case, the part of the VACT that controls the self-diffusion of the particle couples to the antisymmetric part of the FACT, with a coupling strength set by the ratio of the cyclotron frequency to the thermalization rate. We validate and illustrate the formalism on an exactly solvable model: a dimer of charged particles bound by a harmonic potential. Depending on the relative sign of the particle charges, the magnetic field is found to produce either a transient suppression of mobility and diffusion that is fully recovered at long times, or a persistent oscillatory force autocorrelation, regions of negative mobility, and a
  long-time suppression of self-diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了有外磁场时布朗粒子的速度自相关张量(VACT)与力自相关张量(FACT)之间的普适关系，发现过阻尼条件下VACT的扩散部分与FACT的反对称部分耦合，耦合强度由回旋频率与热化率之比决定。通过带电二聚体模型验证，发现磁场可导致瞬态抑制（最终恢复）或持久的振荡、负迁移率及长期扩散抑制。
AI.motivation: 在有磁场存在的情况下，布朗粒子的动力学行为与无磁场情况有本质不同（如霍尔效应、磁致扩散各向异性），但VACT与FACT之间的普适关系尚不明确，作者希望建立不依赖相互作用势细节的一般理论框架。
AI.method: 利用时间对称性论证，基于完整朗之万动力学推导VACT与FACT的一般关系；在时间尺度分离假设下简化到过阻尼极限；通过谐振子束缚的带电二聚体模型进行精确求解验证。
AI.result: 1) VACT仅依赖于FACT，与相互作用势细节无关；2) 过阻尼极限下，控制自扩散的VACT部分与FACT反对称部分耦合，耦合强度为回旋频率/热化率；3) 模型验证显示：同号电荷→瞬态抑制后恢复；异号电荷→持续的力自相关振荡、负迁移率区域、长期扩散抑制。
AI.conclusion: 磁场对布朗运动的影响可产生两种截然不同的行为（瞬态vs持久效应），取决于粒子间相互作用的对称性（如同/异号电荷），这对理解磁性胶体、等离子体等系统的输运性质有重要意义。

title: Fundamental limitations of single-particle Green's-function zeroes as probes of many-body topology
summary: We show that topological invariants constructed from single-particle Green's functions (GFs) cannot reliably diagnose the topology of interacting many-body states. Using coupled interacting SSH chains as a minimal example, we demonstrate that a spin-spin interaction can trivialize the many-body ground state without affecting the GF topological invariant. This breakdown originates from the GF's inability to probe electronic excitations in the Fock sectors responsible for the topological degeneracy. Consequently, GF zeroes are not associated with physical topological quasiparticles and cannot generally characterize interacting topological phases.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，基于单粒子格林函数的拓扑不变量无法可靠诊断相互作用多体态的拓扑性质。通过耦合相互作用SSH链的实例，发现自旋-自旋相互作用可平庸化多体基态而不影响格林函数拓扑不变量。这种失效源于格林函数无法探测负责拓扑简并的Fock区电子激发，因此格林函数零点与物理拓扑准粒子无关，不能普遍表征相互作用拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 传统拓扑不变量在相互作用体系中的适用性存在争议，特别是单粒子格林函数方法在强关联体系中的可靠性尚未明确。本文旨在揭示格林函数拓扑诊断的根本局限性，并阐明其失效的物理根源。
AI.method: 选取耦合相互作用SSH链作为最小模型，构造自旋-自旋相互作用项，比较多体基态拓扑性质与格林函数拓扑不变量之间的对应关系，分析Fock空间中电子激发的探测限制。
AI.result: 自旋-自旋相互作用可以拓扑平庸化多体基态，但格林函数拓扑不变量保持不变；格林函数无法探测负责拓扑简并的Fock区激发，其零点与物理拓扑准粒子无关。
AI.conclusion: 基于单粒子格林函数的拓扑不变量不可靠地诊断相互作用多体态的拓扑序，格林函数零点不能普遍表征相互作用拓扑相。

title: Transition-Metal Tailored $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ Monolayer: From Room-Temperature Gas Sensing to Chemical Scavenging
summary: Pristine $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers suffer from poor sensitivity and weak molecular capture, limiting their application in toxic gas detection and environmental detoxification. Here, we employ first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations to investigate the gas sensing and scavenging properties of $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers substitutionally tailored via seven transition-metals (TM): Pd, Zn, Zr, Mo, Ag, Ti, and Pt. All TM-substituted monolayers exhibit negative formation and binding energies, negligible lattice distortion, and structural stability in molecular dynamics simulations. Performance evaluation against eight toxic industrial and three environmental gases reveals functionalities ranging from selective, reusable room-temperature sensing to permanent molecular capture. Ag substitution exhibits exceptional selectivity for $NO$ with moderate adsorption strength (~-0.83eV), an up to eight-order-of-magnitude conductivity enhancement, besides facilitating reusable $O_2$ and $NO_2$ detection. Additionally, Pd-, Zn-, Zr-, and Mo substitutions tune selectivity toward $NO$, $NO_2$, $CO_2$, $CO$, and $O_2$. Coming to applications towards toxic gas capture, Zr- and Mo-substituted systems selectively scavenge oxidizing gases, whereas Ti and Pt act as universal scavengers. Further analysis reveals that Pd- and Ag-substituted monolayers remain selective for $NO$, while Zn substitution favors $NO_2$ detection even in ambient atmospheric conditions. Thus, these tailored $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers offer a practical platform for atmospheric monitoring and detoxification.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理DFT计算，研究了七种过渡金属(Pd, Zn, Zr, Mo, Ag, Ti, Pt)替代掺杂的Ga₂O₂单层膜在有毒气体检测和清除方面的性能。Ag掺杂对NO具有超高选择性，可实现室温可重复检测；Zr和Mo掺杂可选择性清除氧化性气体，Ti和Pt则是通用清除剂。这些材料为大气监测和解毒提供了实用平台。
AI.motivation: 原始Ga₂O₂单层膜对有毒气体灵敏度低、分子捕获能力弱，限制了其在毒气检测和环境解毒方面的应用。因此需要对其进行改性以提高性能。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论(DFT)计算，对Ga₂O₂单层进行七种过渡金属(TM: Pd, Zn, Zr, Mo, Ag, Ti, Pt)的替代掺杂，并评估其对八种有毒工业气体和三种环境气体的传感与清除性能。
AI.result: 所有TM掺杂体系具有负的形成能和结合能、晶格畸变小、分子动力学结构稳定。Ag掺杂对NO具有超高选择性（吸附能~-0.83eV），电导率提升8个数量级，且可重复检测O₂和NO₂。Pd、Zn、Zr、Mo可调控对NO、NO₂、CO₂、CO、O₂的选择性。Zr和Mo选择性清除氧化性气体，Ti和Pt为通用清除剂。
AI.conclusion: 过渡金属掺杂的Ga₂O₂单层膜为大气中有毒气体监测和环境解毒提供了实用的材料平台，兼顾了选择性传感和永久性捕获的双重功能。

title: Josephson and Spin Currents in Coupled Polariton Condensates
summary: We analyze particle and spin currents in networks of coupled spinor exciton-polariton condensates arranged as plaquettes and regular polygonal rings. In closed geometries, spin-conserving and TE-TM-induced spin-flip tunnelling combine to generate circulating particle currents, hidden spin counterflows, and bond-dependent spin-current patterns. For the minimal geometries - an equilateral triangle, and a square plaquette - we derive analytical expressions for edge-resolved currents from stationary configurations obtained by energy minimization. We then show how particle, in-plane spin, and out-of-plane spin currents partition the parameter plane and provide direct signatures of the equilibrium phases. Finally, we apply the same current-resolved diagnostics to larger rings, where winding numbers and a branch-invariant common-phase coherence metric organize the resulting phase structure.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了耦合自旋激子极化激元凝聚体在平板和正多边形环结构中的粒子流和自旋流，揭示了隐藏的自旋逆流、键依赖的自旋流模式，并利用电流分辨诊断对平衡相进行表征。
AI.motivation: 理解在封闭几何结构中，自旋守恒和TE-TM诱导的自旋翻转隧穿如何共同作用，产生循环粒子流、隐藏自旋逆流和键依赖的自旋流模式，从而揭示平衡相的特征。
AI.method: 通过能量最小化获得稳态构型，推导等边三角形和正方形平板边分辨电流的解析表达式；利用粒子流、面内自旋流和面外自旋流对参数平面进行分区；对大环结构采用绕数和支不变公共相位相干度量组织相结构。
AI.result: 在最小几何结构（等边三角形和正方形平板）中推导出边分辨电流的解析表达式；揭示了粒子流、自旋流如何划分参数平面并提供平衡相的直接特征；在大环结构中，绕数和公共相位相干度量有效组织了相结构。
AI.conclusion: 电流分辨诊断方法能有效表征耦合自旋极化激元凝聚体网络中的平衡相，为理解复杂几何中的自旋和粒子输运提供了新工具。

title: Contrarian Majority Dynamics: Violation of Detailed Balance and Nonequilibrium Steady States
summary: I revisit the Galam Majority Model (GMM) with contrarian agents from a statistical-mechanics perspective, revealing three fundamental features. First, in addition to the GMM simultaneous-update of small discussion groups, I construct a related single-agent stochastic dynamics, providing a Markovian microscopic representation, which is found to yield the same evolution equation. Second, I show that, contrary to what is often stated in the literature, the GMM closed evolution equation for the opinion density is not the result of a mean-field approximation. Indeed, I derive the conventional mean-field dynamics associated with majority-rule interactions and show that it yields a distinct, probabilistic evolution equation contrary the deterministic GMM equation. I therefore identify the GMM as an iterated mean-field dynamics. Third, I investigate the thermodynamic nature of the dynamics obtained from both single-agent and simultaneous updates. Both are shown to violate detailed balance. However, while Kolmogorov's cycle condition is satisfied for single-agent updates, it is violated for simultaneous updates, making the departure from equilibrium stronger in the latter case. I then compute the probability flux in the stationary state and show that it is non-vanishing, confirming the absence of an effective Hamiltonian and establishing that the stationary state is a genuine nonequilibrium steady state.These results clarify the statistical-mechanical foundations of the GMM and establish contrarian majority dynamics as an intrinsically non-equilibrium process with distinct regimes of irreversibility. Contrarians are not thermal noise.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计力学角度重新审视了带有逆向者（contrarian）的Galam多数投票模型（GMM），揭示了三个基本特征：（1）构建了等价的单智能体随机动力学；（2）澄清GMM演化方程并非平均场近似结果，而是迭代平均场动力学；（3）证明了该动力学违背细致平衡，且同时更新版本甚至违背Kolmogorov循环条件，确认了稳态为非平衡稳态。
AI.motivation: 作者希望澄清GMM模型的统计力学基础，特别是纠正文献中关于GMM演化方程是平均场近似的错误认识，并深入理解逆向者多数投票动力学是否属于热力学平衡过程。
AI.method: 作者采用统计力学方法，构建了单智能体马尔可夫随机动力学，推导了传统的平均场动力学方程，并利用细致平衡检验、Kolmogorov循环条件和概率流计算来分析模型的非平衡特性。
AI.result: （1）构造了与GMM等价的单智能体随机动力学；（2）证明了GMM方程并非平均场近似，而是迭代平均场动力学；（3）两种更新方式均违背细致平衡，但同时更新还违背Kolmogorov循环条件，非平衡性更强；（4）稳态概率流不为零，确认了稳态为真正的非平衡稳态。
AI.conclusion: 逆向者多数投票动力学本质上是非平衡过程，具有不同的不可逆性区域；逆向者不能被简单视为热噪声。

title: Anomalous thermopower from the drag of overdamped collective modes
summary: Inspired by the observation of a Seebeck coefficient ratio that exhibits a seemingly logarithmic divergence at low temperature in high-temperature superconducting cuprates, we show that a mechanisms similar to the standard phonon drag can give rise to anomalies in the thermopower of a metal, if the dragged collective mode is overdamped, with a damping coefficient that increases with lowering the temperature. Our finding adds a piece to the puzzle of the strange-metal behavior observed in many different systems and supports our proposal that overdamped charge density fluctuations can be responsible of such a behavior in high-temperature superconducting cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出过阻尼集体模式的类声子拖曳机制可解释高温超导铜氧化物中塞贝克系数比在低温下的对数发散异常，支持过阻尼电荷密度涨落是奇异金属行为起源的观点。
AI.motivation: 高温超导铜氧化物中观测到塞贝克系数比在低温下呈现对数发散行为，现有理论无法解释这一奇异金属现象，亟需提出新的物理机制。
AI.method: 受标准声子拖曳机制启发，将该机制推广至过阻尼集体模式（如电荷密度涨落），并假设阻尼系数随温度降低而增大，从而推导热电势的异常行为。
AI.result: 过阻尼集体模式的拖曳效应可产生塞贝克系数比在低温下的对数发散，重现实验观测到的异常行为。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为奇异金属行为提供了新的理论视角，支持了过阻尼电荷密度涨落是高温超导铜氧化物中奇异金属行为根源的观点。

title: A depth resolved investigation of hydrogen uptake in carbon based nanostructures by soft-to-hard photoemission spectroscopy
summary: Hydrogen chemisorption on graphitic carbon modifies the carbon orbital hybridization from sp2 to sp3, altering both structural and electronic properties. Understanding not only the lateral extent but also the depth distribution of hydrogen uptake in three-dimensional carbon architectures is essential for both fundamental studies and storage applications. To this end, we investigate here the evolution of the C 1s core-level lineshape in nanoporous graphene (NPG) and vertically aligned carbon nanotubes (CNTs) upon hydrogenation, exploiting soft-to-hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy to achieve a depth-resolved analysis. Decomposition of the C 1s spectra reveals the formation of an sp3 rich overlayer in both systems, with an effective thickness ranging from a fraction of a graphitic monolayer (NPG) to approximately one graphitic layer (CNTs), indicating limited hydrogen penetration beneath the outermost accessible surfaces. Overall, hydrogenation in both materials remains predominantly localized on the surface. These results clarify the spatial distribution of hydrogen in curved and porous graphitic networks and provide quantitative constraints on its chemisorption for carbon-based hydrogen storage applications.

AI.tldr: 本文利用软X射线到硬X射线的光电子能谱，对纳米多孔石墨烯（NPG）和垂直排列碳纳米管（CNTs）的氢化行为进行了深度分辨分析。研究发现，两种材料的氢化主要集中在最外层表面，形成的sp³富集层厚度仅相当于单层石墨烯的一小部分（NPG）到约一个石墨层（CNTs），表明氢渗透深度有限。
AI.motivation: 理解氢在三维碳结构中不仅横向分布、还有深度方向的分布情况，对于基础研究和储氢应用都至关重要。现有研究对氢在曲面和多孔石墨网络中的空间分布认识不足。
AI.method: 采用软X射线到硬X射线光电子能谱（soft-to-hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy）进行深度分辨分析，通过解析C 1s核心能级线形变化来研究氢化过程中sp²到sp³的转变。
AI.result: 两种材料（NPG和CNTs）氢化后均形成sp³富集的表层，有效厚度从不到一个石墨烯单层（NPG）到约一个石墨层（CNTs），氢渗透深度有限，氢化主要局限在最外层表面。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了氢在曲面和多孔石墨网络中的空间分布规律，为碳基储氢应用中的氢化学吸附提供了定量约束条件。

title: Coupled Spin-Orbital $p$-Wave Magnetism via Structural and Magnetic Chirality
summary: Helical spin textures represent the minimal realization of $p$-wave magnetism which is characterized by momentum-odd spin polarization. Independently, structurally chiral crystals exhibit momentum-odd orbital polarization arising from broken inversion symmetry. Here, we demonstrate that spin-orbit coupling couples these two independent microscopic chirality degrees of freedom, allowing the orbital polarization of a chiral crystal to generate an additional contribution to the $p$-wave spin splitting. The resulting spin-orbital state is naturally classified by the relative chirality $η=χ_{\mathrm c}χ_{\mathrm m}$, giving rise to two symmetry-distinct $p$-wave phases corresponding to homochiral and heterochiral configurations which can be directly probed by the longitudinal conductivity. These phases exhibit distinct transport signatures, establishing relative chirality as an experimentally accessible symmetry degree of freedom in chiral magnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了手性晶体中自旋-轨道耦合如何将轨道手性与自旋手性耦合，定义了相对手性η这一新的对称性自由度，并预言了两种p波自旋劈裂相及其不同的电导特征。
AI.motivation: 探索手性晶体中自旋轨道耦合如何将轨道极化（结构手性）与自旋极化（p波磁性）这两个独立的微观手性自由度耦合起来，并研究其物理后果。
AI.method: 基于对称性分析和自旋-轨道耦合理论，引入相对手性η=χ_cχ_m作为分类参数，区分同手性和异手性两种p波相，并通过纵向电导率进行可观测预测。
AI.result: 发现了两种对称性不同的p波相：同手性相和异手性相，它们可由纵向电导率直接区分。
AI.conclusion: 相对手性是一个实验上可探测的对称性自由度，对理解手性磁系统中的自旋输运具有重要意义。

title: Correlation and entanglement dynamics of free fermions in disguise
summary: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics following a quantum quench in spin chains that can be solved via a mapping to free fermions in disguise. These models feature an exponential degeneracy of all energy eigenvalues, raising the question of the validity of the established framework describing the properties of integrable systems out of equilibrium. We present two main results. First, we develop an analytic method to compute the quasi-momentum distribution function characterizing the generalized Gibbs ensemble, and derive an analytic formula to compute the corresponding expectation values for special observables. Second, we conjecture a modification of the standard formula for the entanglement growth based on the quasi-particle picture, taking into account that each fermion in disguise carries an additional amount of entropy due to the exponential degeneracy of the energy eigenvalues. We test our theoretical predictions against numerical tensor-network computations for different initial states and Hamiltonian parameters. For the local observables, we find excellent agreement. For the entanglement dynamics, we find small deviations suggesting that our conjecture is only approximately correct. Our results represent a first step towards the extension of the established framework of integrable systems out of equilibrium to models hosting free fermions in disguise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可映射为自由费米子的自旋链在量子淬火后的非平衡动力学，发现由于能量本征值的指数简并性，标准可积系统框架需要修正。作者提出了广义Gibbs系综中准动量分布的解析计算方法，并基于准粒子图像提出了纠缠增长公式的修正猜想，通过数值张量网络计算验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 这类可映射为自由费米子的自旋链模型具有能量本征值指数简并的特殊性质，这挑战了现有关于可积系统非平衡动力学的理论框架的有效性，因此需要研究并扩展该框架。
AI.method: 1. 发展解析方法计算广义Gibbs系综中的准动量分布函数；2. 推导特殊可观测量期望值的解析公式；3. 基于准粒子图像提出纠缠增长公式的修正猜想，考虑每个"伪装"费米子因能量简并携带额外熵；4. 使用张量网络数值计算验证理论预测。
AI.result: 对于局域可观测量，理论与数值结果高度一致；对于纠缠动力学，存在微小偏差，表明所提出的修正猜想仅近似正确。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为将可积系统非平衡动力学的标准框架扩展到包含"伪装"自由费米子的模型迈出了第一步。

title: Anisotropic nanoscale coherent polariton transport in CrSBr
summary: In a combined experimental and theoretical study, we demonstrate anisotropic polariton transport on the nanoscale in the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrSBr. While effective cavity-polariton formation emerges via the self-hybridization of ultra-high oscillator strength excitons with a thin slab photonic mode, the absence of external mirrors facilitates spectroscopic investigation of these polaritons via cathodoluminescence (CL) on length scales determined by the electron wavelength. This direct access allows us to perform precise charting of the polariton landscape with nanometric resolution, and to probe polariton interference phenomena. The main finding of the work highlights that the coherent polariton transport follows the $C_{2v}$ symmetry of CrSBr, allowing exclusive transport along the crystallographic a-axis, while no coherent feature is found along the b-axis direction. Our work sets the foundation to use CL spectroscopy in cavity-polaritonics in more advanced landscapes, such as photonic crystals or optical lattices, and establishes the technique as a powerful tool to probe anisotropic expansion and relaxation phenomena on the nanoscale

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验与理论结合，展示了在范德华反铁磁体CrSBr中，激子与薄片光子模式自杂化形成的腔极化激元在纳米尺度上的各向异性传输。利用阴极发光光谱，以纳米分辨率精确测绘了极化激元景观，发现其相干传输遵循CrSBr的C₂v对称性，仅沿晶体a轴方向进行，而b轴方向无相干特征。
AI.motivation: 传统腔极化激元研究依赖外部反射镜，限制了在纳米尺度上直接探测极化激元的传输行为。本文旨在利用无需外部镜面的自杂化极化激元体系，结合阴极发光技术，实现高空间分辨率的极化激元探测，揭示各向异性传输机制。
AI.method: 采用实验（阴极发光光谱）与理论相结合的方法：利用CrSBr中超高振子强度的激子与薄片光子模式自杂化形成腔极化激元；通过电子束激发产生阴极发光，实现纳米尺度空间分辨的极化激元测绘和干涉现象观测。
AI.result: 极化激元的相干传输严格遵循CrSBr的C₂v对称性：沿晶体a轴方向存在明确的相干传输，而b轴方向无相干特征。成功实现了对极化激元景观的纳米级精确定位和干涉现象的探测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为利用阴极发光光谱在更复杂的光子结构（如光子晶体、光学晶格）中进行腔极化激元学研究奠定了基础，同时确立了CL技术作为探测纳米尺度各向异性扩展和弛豫现象的有力工具。

title: Intrinsic orbital Hall effect in a nonuniform electric field
summary: Geometric analysis of electronic Bloch states offers a universal framework for understanding electronic properties, yet its role in the transport of orbital angular momentum remains unexplored. In this work, we establish an analytic connection between orbital angular momentum transport and the geometric properties of Bloch wave functions in electronic systems. Focusing on the intrinsic orbital Hall effect in the dc limit under a spatially nonuniform electric field, we show that its conductivity can be expressed in terms of universal geometric quantities, such as the orbital Berry curvature and quantum metric. This formulation provides a term-by-term correspondence with the geometric description of intrinsic charge Hall transport established in previous studies. Using a tight-binding model, we further illustrate that the higher-order orbital Hall response can exhibit enhanced sensitivity to the orientation of an anisotropic sample. Our work deepens the understanding of diverse intrinsic transverse transport phenomena and the role of quantum geometry in electronic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了电子系统中轨道角动量输运与布洛赫波函数几何性质之间的解析联系，揭示了轨道霍尔效应电导率可由轨道贝里曲率和量子度量等几何量表达，并展示了高阶轨道霍尔响应对各向异性样品取向的增强敏感性。
AI.motivation: 虽然几何分析已广泛应用于理解电子性质，但轨道角动量输运中的几何作用尚未被探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过解析推导建立轨道角动量输运与布洛赫波函数几何性质的联系，利用紧束缚模型进行数值验证。
AI.result: 轨道霍尔效应电导率可表示为轨道贝里曲率和量子度量等几何量；高阶轨道霍尔响应对各向异性样品取向具有增强敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 加深了对本征横向输运现象的理解，揭示了量子几何在电子系统中的重要作用。

title: On the emergence of quantum many-body chaos for tunably-broken integrability
summary: We develop a quantitative theory for the emergence of quantum many-body chaos as integrability is broken via a tunable parameter. In a circuit model of free fermions, 'doped' with a tunable density of integrability-breaking gates, we uncover the microscopic mechanisms underpinning the crossover from early-time integrable behaviour to late-time chaos through the lens of the out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). The integrability-breaking gates act as local, in spacetime, hotspots which locally amplify the OTOCs such that an accumulation of them eventually leads to fully-developed chaos. We identify the explicit characteristic time and length scales governing this crossover, as well as the dependence of the chaotic OTOC characteristics -- such as the butterfly velocity and front broadening -- on the integrability-breaking parameter.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可调参数破坏可积性，在自由费米子电路中掺杂可积性破坏门，研究量子多体混沌的涌现机制。利用OTOC揭示了从早期可积行为到晚期混沌的微观机制，并确定了特征时间尺度、长度尺度以及蝴蝶速度等混沌特征对破坏参数的依赖。
AI.motivation: 量子多体混沌的涌现机制尚不清晰，尤其是在可积性被逐渐破坏的过程中，微观层面的动力学如何从可积行为过渡到混沌行为缺乏定量理论解释。
AI.method: 在自由费米子电路模型中引入可调密度的可积性破坏门（局部时空热点），通过分析OTOC的传播与放大，研究混沌的逐步发展过程。
AI.result: 找到了控制这一交叉行为的特征时间和长度尺度；揭示了OTOC的蝴蝶速度、前沿展宽等混沌特征对可积性破坏参数的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了可积性破坏导致量子混沌涌现的定量理论，验证了局部热点累积驱动混沌发展的微观图像。

title: Coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy integrated with confocal back focal plane microscopy
summary: We introduce a setup for coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy in the pump-probe reflection geometry that is integrated with a confocal back focal plane imaging microscope. The angle-resolved capability is utilized to control pump and probe wavevectors, while real space imaging enables co-localization of the collection spots for linear and ultrafast experiments. Compression of pulses down to 20 fs is achieved. We demonstrate the capabilities of this approach on an exfoliated WSe$_2$ monolayer on Si/SiO$_2$. The setup is suited to investigate excitons and exciton-polaritons in 2D Materials and their heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种集成共聚焦背焦平面成像显微镜的泵浦-探测反射几何相干二维电子光谱装置，实现了角度分辨、20 fs脉冲压缩，并在WSe₂单层上验证了其性能，适用于研究二维材料中的激子和激子-极化激元。
AI.motivation: 现有二维电子光谱技术在应用于二维材料及其异质结构时，缺乏同时具备角度分辨、空间共定位和高时间分辨能力的反射几何装置，无法有效研究激子和激子-极化激元。
AI.method: 将相干二维电子光谱与泵浦-探测反射几何结合，集成共聚焦背焦平面成像显微镜，利用角度分辨能力控制泵浦和探测波矢，通过实空间成像实现线性与超快实验收集点的共定位，并将脉冲压缩至20 fs。
AI.result: 在Si/SiO₂上的剥离WSe₂单层上成功演示了该装置的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该装置适用于研究二维材料及其异质结构中的激子和激子-极化激元。

title: Differentiable inverse design of short-range order in high-entropy alloys: from target sro to target property
summary: Short-range order (SRO) governs the mechanical response of multi-principal-element alloys, but designing an alloy for a target property usually means solving two disconnected problems: building a structure matching a desired SRO pattern, then separately checking its property, with no shared optimization. This work replaces the standard random-swap search (reverse Monte Carlo) with a gradient-based approach: atom occupancy is treated as continuous rather than fixed, so the whole process can be tuned using gradient descent, the same method used to train neural networks. This builder matches random-swap accuracy on small systems, but is six times faster and eight times more accurate on large 4000-atom systems, and scales smoothly to alloys with many elements without extra bookkeeping. A physics-based correction term, adapted from prior two-element work and extended here to many elements, keeps designed structures thermodynamically realistic rather than just numerically matching the target SRO pattern. A small neural network then predicts mechanical properties directly from composition and SRO statistics, closing the loop from target property back to structure. Tested on nine face-centered-cubic and body-centered-cubic alloys, the pipeline captured SRO-driven stiffness changes from -20% to +57%, and cell-size checks showed at least 864 atoms are needed to get the direction and size of these changes right, since the commonly used 108-atom cells can mislead. Against real simulations for a cobalt-chromium-nickel alloy, the method matched three of four target stiffness values within 6%. The method is released as an open-source Python package, anisro, offering a practical route to gradient-based, property-driven alloy design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于梯度下降的短程有序（SRO）结构构建方法，替代传统的随机交换搜索。该方法将原子占据视为连续变量，速度更快、精度更高，并支持多元素合金。结合一个预测力学性能的小型神经网络，实现了从目标性能到结构的闭环优化。开源工具包名为 anisro。
AI.motivation: 传统方法中，构建SRO结构和评估材料性能是两个独立步骤，缺乏联合优化。作者希望用梯度下降统一两个过程，实现从目标性能直接反推结构的高效设计。
AI.method: 将原子占据视为连续变量（而非离散），使梯度下降可调；引入物理修正项保证热力学合理性；用小型神经网络从成分和SRO统计量预测力学性能，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在4000原子大体系上，速度比随机交换快6倍，精度高8倍；在9种FCC/BCC合金上，捕捉到-20%到+57%的SRO驱动刚度变化；证明至少864原子才能正确反映SRO对性能的影响，而常用的108原子单元可能误导。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了从目标性能到结构的梯度驱动设计，具有高效、可扩展、热力学合理的特点，并以开源工具包形式发布，为多主元合金的逆向设计提供了实用工具。

title: From Bloch to Néel: Anisotropy-dependent Domain-Wall Character in FePd Thin Films
summary: We report an experimental investigation of the depth-dependent domain wall formation in L1$_0$-FePd thin films with high perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Using circular dichroism X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (CD-XRMS) as a function of the incident X-ray angle, we explore the depth evolution of chiral spin textures in two samples with different strengths of magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Combined with CD-STXM, CD-ptychography, and macroscopic characterization of the structural order, magnetic properties, and surface morphology, we relate these observations to differences in the long-range order of the L1$_0$ phase of FePd. One FePd thin film with very high magnetocrystalline anisotropy, characterized by $Q_{PMA}=1.8$, exhibits an unexpectedly large Néel contribution. Angular-dependent CD-XRMS directly reveals a smooth transition from a hybrid Bloch-Néel chirality within the upper FePd layer towards a purely Néel-type structure at the lower FePd interface. In the second FePd sample, despite a still relatively large $Q_{PMA}=1.45$, the domain walls were found to be purely Néel type. These results indicate a crucial role of the long-range structural order in determining the formation of the magnetic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过X射线磁性共振散射等技术，研究了L1₀-FePd薄膜中随深度变化的畴壁结构。发现高磁晶各向异性样品（Q=1.8）表现出从混合Bloch-Néel到纯Néel型畴壁的平滑过渡，而另一样品（Q=1.45）则为纯Néel型，揭示了长程结构有序对磁畴壁形成的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 探究L1₀-FePd薄膜中手性自旋织构随深度的演化规律，以及磁晶各向异性强度对畴壁类型的影响，特别是长程有序度在其中的作用。
AI.method: 采用圆二色X射线共振磁散射（CD-XRMS）随入射角变化的方式，结合CD-STXM、CD-ptychography以及宏观结构有序度、磁性能和表面形貌表征，系统分析两种不同磁晶各向异性强度的FePd薄膜样品。
AI.result: 高各向异性样品（Q=1.8）中观察到从上层混合Bloch-Néel手性到下层纯Néel型结构的平滑过渡；另一样品（Q=1.45）则表现出纯Néel型畴壁。
AI.conclusion: 长程结构有序度在决定磁畴壁结构形成中起关键作用，而非仅由磁晶各向异性强度决定。

title: Ultrafast Demagnetization Governed by Spin Fluctuations in CaRuO$_{3}$/SrTiO$_{3}$ Superlattice
summary: For ultrafast magnetization switching devices, critical slowing down in conventional ferromagnets near their Curie temperature constitutes a key challenge that must be overcome. In contrast to this typical behavior, we observe an anomalous acceleration of demagnetization in CaRuO$_{3}$/SrTiO$_{3}$ superlattices, a moderately correlated weak itinerant ferromagnet. The demagnetization rate increases with rising temperature, pump fluence, and applied magnetic field. To explain these anomalous phenomena, we develop a phenomenological model integrating the three-temperature model with self-consistent renormalization theory. Because the intrinsic gradient magnetism of the superlattice suppresses the typical divergence of specific heat, the conventional thermodynamic bottleneck is bypassed. Our model reveals that this decoupling enables the ultrafast dynamics to be predominantly governed by the spin-fluctuation-driven enhancement of the electron-spin scattering vertex. Our work demonstrates how spatial inhomogeneity can decouple macroscopic thermodynamic singularities from microscopic scattering processes, offering a new paradigm for manipulating ultrafast spin dynamics in correlated quantum materials. The pronounced sensitivity of the demagnetization rate to external parameters further suggests the potential for designing highly tunable ultrafast spintronic devices that leverage enhanced fluctuations near the magnetic instability.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中，退磁速率随温度、泵浦通量和外加磁场增加而反常加速，通过结合三温度模型与自洽重整化理论，揭示了自旋涨落驱动的电子-自旋散射增强机制，为超快自旋动力学调控提供了新范式。
AI.motivation: 传统铁磁体在居里温度附近存在临界减速问题，限制了超快磁化开关器件的性能，亟需寻找克服这一瓶颈的新机制。
AI.method: 在三温度模型中引入自洽重整化理论，建立唯象模型；实验上观测CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中退磁速率对温度、泵浦通量和磁场的依赖性。
AI.result: 发现该超晶格中退磁速率随温度、泵浦通量和外加磁场升高而反常加速，超晶格固有的梯度磁性抑制了比热容的发散，从而绕过了传统热力学瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 空间不均匀性可将宏观热力学奇点与微观散射过程解耦，为设计高可调谐的超快自旋电子器件提供了新途径。

title: Interfacial Strain and Structural Defects Govern the Performance of Tantalum Superconducting Waveguide Resonators
summary: Tantalum (Ta) is a promising material for reaching long coherence times in superconducting qubits. A detailed understanding of the underlying structure-property relationship remains elusive though. In the present study, we sputter-deposited 200 nm thick Ta films on high-resistivity silicon (100) substrates at temperatures ranging from T = 20°C to 600°C, as well as on different seed layers (Nb, TiN and TaN). Alpha-Ta thin films were readily obtained at temperatures above 500°C and on all seed layers. The films were characterized in terms of surface morphology, residual-resistance ratio, crystal phase composition and superconducting transition temperature, as well as RF-performance using coplanar waveguide resonators. Internal quality factors of up to 1.5 million were measured at 100 mK in the single-photon regime. Despite similar bulk material properties, alpha-Ta films on different seed layers exhibit markedly different RF-performance, which we attribute to dissimilar strain and structural defects at the substrate-metal interfaces. Williamson-Hall analysis of XRD data reveals a clear correlation between decreasing microstrain and increasing quality factor. Cross-sectional HR-TEM further supports this interpretation by directly resolving interfacial disorder. Our results highlight the critical role of interface engineering in optimizing superconducting thin films for low-loss quantum computing circuitry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了溅射沉积的α-Ta薄膜在不同温度及种子层上的结构-性能关系，发现界面应变和缺陷显著影响超导量子比特的射频性能，内禀品质因数最高达150万，揭示了界面工程对低损耗量子计算电路的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 钽（Ta）在超导量子比特中具有实现长相干时间的潜力，但其结构-性能关系的详细理解仍然缺乏。
AI.method: 在20°C至600°C温度范围内及不同种子层（Nb、TiN、TaN）上溅射沉积200 nm厚的Ta薄膜，通过表面形貌、残余电阻比、晶体相组成、超导转变温度及共面波导谐振器进行射频性能表征。
AI.result: 在100 mK单光子条件下测得内禀品质因数高达150万；不同种子层上的α-Ta薄膜虽体材料性质相似，但射频性能差异显著；Williamson-Hall分析显示微应变与品质因数呈负相关；HR-TEM直接证实了界面无序的存在。
AI.conclusion: 界面工程对于优化用于低损耗量子计算电路的超导薄膜至关重要。

title: Bottlenecks in Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation Method for Modeling Interfaces
summary: The Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation (H-AdResS) method allows to combine atomistic and particle-based coarse-grained models in a single simulation box, which makes it very attractive to model systems containing interfaces or reactive regions surrounded by an interacting environment. In our previous work [arXiv:2604.21867], we implemented H-AdResS in LAMMPS 2023 and extended its use to interfaces, focusing on MOF/CO$_2$ interfaces as an example. We found that, despite its advantages, using this method properly for this kind of systems is not trivial. In this work, an in-depth analysis of the impact of the choice of thermostatting schemes and long-range electrostatics models is presented. Even though its Hamiltonian formulation enables performing H-AdResS simulations within constant temperatures ensembles, not every thermostat is appropriate. We demonstrate that Langevin thermostat is a reliable choice for this method, while Nosé-Hoover results in artifacts. In addition, we show that using short-range models such as the Damped Shifted Force method for electrostatics, a popular choice for H-AdResS simulations, can lead to non-physical results when modeling interfaces. The need of capping strategies to deal with discontinuities in forces and energies arising from abrupt changes in resolution is also discussed. Finally, the impossibility of changing the definition of the H-AdResS Hamiltonian to include a gradual interpolation of the bonded degrees of freedom is discussed. We hope that this contribution helps the reader to appropriately set up H-AdResS simulations and to assess if this method can be used to accurately model their system of interest.
